translate_en|mods/SignatureWeapons/42/me: On death your claimed weapons revert to legacy weapons and free your claim slots.
Claimed weapons never degrade. When off, signature weapons wear and are repaired like any other weapon, but keep their name, kill tracking, and damage bonus.
Claimed bladed weapons never dull. When off, signature weapons keep full durability but must be sharpened normally.

Restores the original progression: +5%% damage per level to +50%% at level 10, with infinite durability from the moment you claim a weapon. When off, weapons use the tiered system - damage in five +10%% steps on levels 1/3/5/7/9, and an unlock on each even level (2: never degrades, 4: attack speed, 6: critical chance, 8: range, 10: legendary). Kill thresholds and the panic/stress calming are the same either way.
How many weapons you may have claimed at once.
Percent faster at level 4: swing time for melee weapons, reload/aiming/recoil delay for firearms. Ignored by the legacy reward system.
Percentage points added to a weapon's critical chance at level 6. Ignored by the legacy reward system.
Percent increase to a weapon's maximum reach at level 8. Minimum range is left alone, so close-in fighting is unaffected. Ignored by the legacy reward system.
How fast claimed weapons level up (1:  normal / 2:  twice as fast).
